proposal.expected_benefit: This will reduce ambiguity in control implementation, ensure audit-before-execution is strictly enforced, and prevent contradictions between audit and compliance decisions, thereby improving the robustness of the system's risk management framework.
proposal.problem: Ambiguity in the control implementation between audit status and compliance decisions may lead to contradictions and reduce the robustness of the system.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a clear and explicit policy that defines the precedence and interaction between audit and compliance controls. This should include a documented process for resolving conflicts, ensuring that audit requirements are not overridden unless explicitly authorized through a defined compliance pathway.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement in Control Implementation
verification_tests: Validate that audit status is not overridden by compliance decisions unless explicitly authorized.
Ensure that audit and compliance controls are clearly defined and documented.
Confirm that the system can resolve conflicts between audit and compliance requirements in a consistent and predictable manner.
